name: Scorching Desert
desc1: White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation
desc2: confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The
desc3: heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh
desc4: bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging
desc5: overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel
desc6: eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.
